data.name: Sharwanami
data.gender_notes: Sharwanami is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharwanami is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharva', which refers to the Hindu God of love and fertility, Lord Shiva. The suffix 'Nami' means 'Lord of'. Thus, Sharwanami can be interpreted as 'Lord of the Vibrant', signifying the radiant and luminous qualities of the God. The name Sharwanami carries the meaning “Lord of the Vibrant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharwanami usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the vibrant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharwanami is a name that signifies the divine presence and power of Lord Shiva. It is a name that evokes feelings of love, fertility, and vibrancy, and is believed to bring blessings of prosperity and abundance.
data.etymology: Sharwanami belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Vibrant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharwanami total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
